summary.tldr: Adds Criminal Code offences for intimidating health care professionals to take part in medical assistance in dying, or for hiring or firing them only for refusing.
what_it_does: Creates a Criminal Code offence for using coercion or other intimidation to compel a medical practitioner, nurse practitioner, pharmacist, or other health care professional to take part, directly or indirectly, in medical assistance in dying.

Makes it an offence to refuse to employ a medical practitioner, nurse practitioner, pharmacist, or other health care professional for the reason only that they refuse to take part, directly or indirectly, in medical assistance in dying.

Makes it an offence to dismiss a medical practitioner, nurse practitioner, pharmacist, or other health care professional for the reason only that they refuse to take part, directly or indirectly, in medical assistance in dying.
summary.background: The bill would add section 241.21 to the Criminal Code.
